title: The Positive answer from the office
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：positive　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 positive 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the trader wrote of ① a positive answer from the office in the list, and everybody in the market said at once that it was ② more positive than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the trader, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the positive ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most positive answer from the office anybody in the market had ever seen, or so the list for October 1955 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too positive to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the partner who had come to help; the positive ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a positive attitude of the pupils, and said that no partner in his right mind would call it ⑥ as positive as the attitude of the pupils they had once had in the old market. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was positive or not, and he said so.

By 1968 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something positive, and nothing besides. The partner from the next market called the whole plan ⑧ quite positive; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the positive ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1971, with great care, she wrote of another positive answer from the office in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more positive than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most positive attitude of the pupils in the whole market, she said in 1973, was the one she could never quite name; the positive ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 积极（前置定语 a positive answer from the office：1961 年货商在货单里记下的那件积极的答复）
B. adj. 积极／肯定（比较级 more positive than：文中两处，一处比办公室肯定的答复，一处比预想）
C. adj. 积极／肯定（最高级 the most positive：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 积极（表语 too positive to do：母亲觉得它太积极，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 肯定（前置定语 a positive attitude of the pupils：叔叔把整件事称作一桩肯定的态度）
F. adj. 肯定（同级比较 as positive as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学生积极的态度相比）
G. adj. 肯定（后置定语 something positive：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 肯定（受程度副词修饰 quite positive：那位伙计的评价）

items.q: a positive answer from the office
the most positive answer from the office anybody
a positive attitude of the pupils
The most positive attitude of the pupils in

answers.why: positive 意为“积极”，1961 年货商在货单里记下的是“一件积极的答复”，此处作前置定语 a positive answer from the office。
positive 意为“积极”，此处用比较级 more positive than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
positive 意为“积极”，货单上 十月 那行字说它是集市里最积极的一件，故用最高级 the most positive answer from the office。
positive 意为“积极”，母亲认为这件东西“太积极了，谁也用不上”，too positive to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
positive 意为“肯定”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩肯定的态度”，此处作前置定语 a positive attitude of the pupils。
positive 意为“肯定”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学生积极的态度一样肯定”，同级比较用 as positive as。
positive 意为“肯定”，货单上那半行字要的是“肯定的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something positive。
positive 意为“肯定”，邻集市来的那位伙计认为这套计划“相当肯定”，quite 修饰原级 positive。
positive 意为“肯定”，1971 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要肯定”，故用比较级 more positive than。
positive 意为“肯定”，母亲 1973 年说的是“整个集市里最肯定的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most positive attitude of the pupils。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1961 年，货商在货单里记下了一件积极的答复。（a positive answer from the office）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更积极。（more positive than …）
母亲觉得它太积极，谁也用不上。（too positive to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩肯定的态度。（a positive attitude of the pupils）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学生积极的态度一样肯定。（as positive as …）
到了 1968 年，货单上只剩半行字：要的是一件肯定的东西。（something positive）
answers: In 1961 the trader wrote of a positive answer from the office in the list.
Everybody said it was more positive than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too positive to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a positive attitude of the pupils.
He said nobody would call it as positive as the attitude of the pupils they had once had.
By 1968 the list asked for nothing but something positive.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 positive 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the trader wrote of a positive answer from the office in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most positive answer from the office in the market, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too positive to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a positive attitude of the pupils, and nobody argued with him.
The partner from the next market called the plan quite positive, and everybody laughed.
The positive ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
